item.title: State Department Plans to Revoke Passports of Parents Who Owe Over $100k in Child Support
item.description: The federal government is preparing to intensify efforts against parents who owe more than $100,000 in unpaid child support. Officials said the proposal would expand existing passport denial policies and could lead to revocation of valid passports.
